name: Genesis One
look: a curled translucent-pink Mew with rib-like bands and a heavy-lidded grey-green eye, floating inside a banded pink ring from which three glowing rainbow DNA helices spiral out
entry: A Pokémon resembling Mew, described in an expedition report about a cave where life itself was said to begin. The strands that spiral from its ring are said to hold the code of every Pokémon that has ever lived.
how: Wild: very rare in lush caves.
